summary: Official SkyDeck program page lists Batch 23 applications opening July 2026 with an August 21, 2026 deadline and a Nov 2026-Apr 2027 cohort.

proposed_event.name: Berkeley SkyDeck Batch 23
proposed_event.description: UC Berkeley accelerator offering $210K investment, mentorship, workspace, resources, and Demo Day access.

dates.date_range_text: Applications open July 2026 and close August 21, 2026; program runs November 2, 2026-April 15, 2027.

sources.title: Program - Berkeley SKYDECK
sources.supports: Supports Batch 23 timeline: applications open July 2026, close August 21, 2026; interviews September 8-October 5, 2026; orientation November 2, 2026; program November 2, 2026-April 15, 2027; accelerator investment of $210,000; six-month BAM program; industry-agnostic eligibility.

sources.title: APPLY - Berkeley SKYDECK
sources.supports: Supports organizer/location and program facts: Berkeley SkyDeck is a UC Berkeley program at 2150 Shattuck Avenue, Berkeley; startups receive investment, advisor access, roundtables, workshops, events, workspace, and in-kind resource partner support; Batch 23 applications open in July.

notes: The official apply page still displays the Batch 22 timeline, but its header says Batch 23 applications open in July; the program page provides the more current Batch 23 detailed timeline.
The program page lists 'Cohort Demo Day April, 2026' while the cohort runs November 2026-April 2027, so demo_day is left null rather than inferring April 2027.
The source website in the input uses /programs/accelerator/, but the current official content resolves at /program/.
